notablePrerequisites: You control another transforming double-faced creature.
description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another transforming double-faced creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature to become a copy of Enduring Angel.
Whenever your life total would be reduced to 0 or less, the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached sets your life total to 3 instead and transforms itself.
Because Blade of Shared Souls remains attached to the creature, it continues being a copy of Enduring Angel despite transforming.
Repeat from step 3.
